geometry_basis.source: geometry/site_boundary.geojson (submitted, based on public data, not official)
geometry_basis.policy: All area/ratio metrics below are derived from the submitted geometry, not from officially approved boundary. They are subject to recalculation once the official boundary is published.

assumptions: Boundary derived from public data; official boundary not provided in the public site package.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: polygon_area(BLDG-001) — footprint of the Zhongzhi 'Full-Stack Sanctuary' concept building ONLY
assumptions: This value is the footprint of a SINGLE concept design building (Zhongzhi Full-Stack Sanctuary, BLDG-001, geometry_role=design_proposal), NOT the district-wide existing building footprint. It must NOT be multiplied by a district-wide FAR to derive total volume; doing so previously created a spurious arithmetic conflict (310,807 m² × FAR 4.0 ≈ 1.24M m² vs. the retained 12.0M m² scenario).
Denominator is provisional boundary, not official.
Denominator is provisional boundary, not official.
Three required detailed-design key areas per AGENT-TASKBOOK.

road_network_density_km_per_km2.reason: Conceptual planning target; will be re-derived after official road-network GIS is published.

blue_green_ratio_target.reason: Design target combining green + public space + water; revised once field-survey data is available.

public_service_coverage_target.reason: Conceptual target requiring official facility GIS; cannot be recomputed from the public package.

total_building_volume_sqm_target.formula: buildable_land_area_sqm * scenario_FAR_target, where buildable_land_area = LU-001 (AI R&D 2,674,562.492) + LU-002 (research/innovation service 2,589,339.239) + LU-004 (commercial 2,782,792.823) = 8,046,694.554 m² (green LU-003 excluded). Self-consistent scenario derivation, NOT an arithmetic conflict.
assumptions: FAR is a scenario assumption (not official control). Conservative: FAR 2.0 → 16.09M m². Neutral: FAR 2.34 → 18.83M m². Optimistic: FAR 2.7 → 21.73M m². All are concept scenarios to be re-derived once official FAR control is published.
total_building_volume_sqm_target.reason: Planning scenario derived from buildable land use areas (geometry/land_use.geojson, fully closed at 11,412,832.7 m² vs site_area 11,412,825.4 m²) × scenario FAR. Official FAR control and floor-area census are absent from the public package, so no single computable value can be asserted; the neutral scenario 18.8M m² is retained for continuity with the previously cited figure.

assumptions: Existing FAR is a scenario assumption. Conservative: FAR 1.3 → 10.46M m². Neutral: FAR 1.5 → 12.07M m². Optimistic: FAR 1.7 → 13.68M m².
retained_floor_area_sqm_target.reason: Retained volume scenario = buildable land area × assumed existing FAR. Official floor-area census is absent; to be recalculated once published.

assumptions: New increment = total − retained under each paired scenario. Conservative: 5.63M m². Neutral: 6.76M m². Optimistic: 8.05M m².
new_floor_area_sqm_target.reason: New-increment scenario derived as total minus retained; official FAR control required before a computable value can be asserted.

floor_area_ratio_control.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package.
